items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the correspondence of the graph of a morphism acts on cycles by the Gysin pullback and the pushforward, and that the transpose correspondence acts in the opposite way (statement lines 660-681). The proof (proof lines 682-715) computes the defining intersection products through Gysin maps and composition of pushforwards. H2: a complete computation.
